title: Neutrality boundary rule guard
description: 建立 upstream neutral/boundary rule guard，先以 deterministic 掃描檢查寫死 host 假設，再以 optional semantic audit 補抓隱性耦合與 stale docs。
acceptance: deterministic 規則可攔截 3KLife/Cocos/html-to-ucuf/task-lock/compute-gate/doc-id 等 protected terms
semantic audit 只作 warn/needs-review，不單獨決定 hard fail
guard 區分 code dead-code 與 doc dead-doc，不把 LLM 當唯一裁決
deterministic / semantic 掃描必須同時涵蓋 .atm/reports/upgrade-proposals/* 與 evidence-store payload
adopter 私有資訊（3KLife / Cocos / UCUF / html-to-ucuf）出現在 upgrade-proposal 或 evidence 內容時 hard fail
notes:
2026-05-05 | 狀態: open | 驗證: pending | 變更: 補 neutrality/boundary rule guard 任務 | 阻塞: none
2026-05-06 v2 規劃書補丁：依附錄 A.2 補強 acceptance（不重啟驗收，僅追加）

brief.label: ATM self-hosting first 開卡
brief.summary: 建立可自動驗證的 neutrality/boundary guard，避免 upstream 再被 adopter 私有假設污染。

input: governance schema 與 local reference plugins 已定義
guard 需同時涵蓋 code 與 docs surfaces
output: protected surface policy 與 CI smoke
contracts.validation_cmd: npm test; npm run typecheck; npm run lint
contracts.rollback_hint: 回退 guard 規格或 reference implementation；不得把 3KLife 私有路徑寫回 upstream protected surfaces。
execution_steps: 定義 banned terms 與 deterministic rules

title: Hash Drift / Version Diff Report
description: 產出機器可讀的 hash-diff-report，比對任兩個 atom version 的 spec/code/test hash 差異與 drift reason。
acceptance: hash-diff-report.schema.json 定義 fromVersion / toVersion / specHashDelta / codeHashDelta / testHashDelta / driftReason
CLI atm registry diff <atomId> --from <v1> --to <v2> --json 輸出符合 schema 的報告
fixtures：identical hash（empty delta）/ all-three-changed / driftReason missing 三種
hash-diff-report 追加 `semanticFingerprintDelta` 與 `lineageContinuity` 欄位，分別描述語意差異與 lineage 是否連續
notes:
2026-05-07 | 狀態: done | 驗證: node scripts/validate-registry-diff.mjs --mode test (3 positive, 2 negative, schema validated)；validate-schemas ok (21 schemas)；validate-cli ok | 變更: upstream commit 9f32e11 新增 hash-diff-report.schema.json + core diff.mjs + CLI registry-diff 指令 + fixtures + validate 腳本，並完成 package.json test/typecheck/lint 串接 | 阻塞: none
